title: Uniform-sign product noise kernel
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $ho\in[0,1]$, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. The product noise kernel on sign vectors, with the uniform distribution on signs as its base distribution, equals the resampling noise kernel at correlation parameter $\rho$ and input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
